info.title: pixeltwin
info.description: Self-hosted visual regression testing. Each operation lists its required permission in `x-permission`. Agents: start with /llms.txt.

token.description: The full token. Shown only in this response.

recent.description: The last 10 builds of the branch, newest first

supersededBy.description: Set when review is "outdated": the check of a newer build of this branch whose approval decided this screen.

kind.description: ignore: skip these pixels; compare: compare only inside the compare areas.

actor.description: The user or project token that acted (an id, like reviewedBy).

post.summary: Create the first admin with the setup token printed in the server log
Log in; sets the pt_session cookie
Get a personal token (Bearer pu_…) for a page served elsewhere, such as a test report
post.description: Same credentials and limits as login, but no cookie: the token acts as the user (with their role) when sent as `Authorization: Bearer`, expires like a session, and ends when the password changes.

201.description: The personal token and its user

post.summary: Log out and end the session
Create a user (there is no self-registration)

patch.summary: Change a user's email or role

delete.summary: Delete a user (never the last admin)

get.summary: List projects (a token sees only its own)

delete.summary: Delete a project with its builds, baselines and tokens

get.summary: List a project's tokens (never their secrets)

post.summary: Create a project token for CI or an agent

200.description: The existing build with this externalId

get.summary: List branches with their latest build: main first, then by latest build (at most 50)
Get a build with its verdict and counts

post.summary: Finalize a build and get its verdict (CI gate: only "passed" is success)
Approve every pending check in the build
Post a screenshot; it is compared with its baseline before the response

meta.description: Check metadata as JSON (name, variant, ignoreRegions, thresholds)

200.description: The check replaced an earlier one for the same snapshot

get.summary: List a build's checks, oldest first
Get a check with its diff

post.summary: Approve a check; its image becomes the baseline
Undo a review: back to pending. Undoing an approval removes the baseline it created, unless a newer one replaced it (409 review_not_resettable)

get.summary: Ignore and compare areas drawn on the check's snapshot (they apply to every check of it)

post.summary: Draw an area on the check's snapshot; the check is compared again at once

201.description: The area and the check compared again

patch.summary: Move or resize an area (its kind stays); the check is compared again at once

200.description: The area and the check compared again

delete.summary: Delete an area; the check is compared again at once

get.summary: Review history of a check: every approval, rejection and undo, newest first
A snapshot's baseline history, newest first
What promoting the branch would change: its screens whose baseline differs from main's

200.description: Screens that would change on main

post.summary: Copy a branch's current baselines to the main branch (after merging), all or some
post.description: URL-encode the branch name: `feature%2Flogin`. Without a body every differing screen is promoted; `snapshotKeys` picks some.

get.summary: Download a screenshot, baseline or diff image (PNG)
